summary: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) filed a Form 6-K announcing a normal course issuer bid to repurchase up to 45 million common shares, representing ~3.24% of shares outstanding at current market price. The bid is subject to TSX and OSFI approval, with purchases expected to commence June 12, 2026 and run through June 11, 2027. RBC's CET1 ratio is 13.5%, indicating adequate capital. The program provides flexibility to manage capital and returns excess cash to shareholders. Watch for regulatory approval and pace of buybacks amid market conditions; no premium or fixed price is offered, aligning with open-market repurchases.
